# roots, not careers pages, because guessing a careers path is how you get a wall of
# 404s. The fingerprint pass resolves each one to its real board and names the vendor.
#   tier A   <=40km    Hamilton and the immediate ring — bikeable to a 30-min drive

#   tier C   100-200km Durham, York north, Barrie, London, Stratford, Peterborough

# post once, on their own board, and wait. An aggregator never sees it.

column1: # === INSURANCE, MUTUALS, CREDIT UNIONS AND PENSIONS =============================
# Old, conservative, well-capitalised, and structurally invisible to juniors.
# Farm mutuals in particular run real .NET and Java shops and advertise nowhere.
# === MANUFACTURING AND INDUSTRIAL WITH IN-HOUSE IT ==============================
# ArcelorMittal Dofasco is already watched. Everyone else on this list runs an ERP,
# a plant-floor system and a small internal dev team, and hires quietly.
# === TECH THAT DOES NOT POST WHERE JUNIORS LOOK =================================
# Waterloo Region especially. Mid-size product companies with their own boards,
# no aggregator syndication, and a habit of hiring from co-op pipelines.
# Hamilton, Burlington, Oakville, Mississauga. The bar for this section is a head
# office here — a Canadian HQ or a divisional office on the same site as the plant —
# not a branch plant run out of Michigan. That is what separates an employer with its
# own IT, ERP, controls and applications people from one that posts only shop-floor
# roles and routes everything else to a parent's global board.
# Verified 2026-09-12: every domain below answered. Four were corrected to where the
# company actually lives now (Taylor Steel .com, Karma Candy .ca, StressCrete -> scgrp,
# Arterra -> arterracanada) and four are named for the parent that now does the hiring
